ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the vertices of $\triangle ABC$ are on the grid points. What is the value of $\cos B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, we select lattice point $D$ such that $\angle ADB=90^\circ$, and connect $AD$ and $BD$.\\
Since $AD=3$ and $BD=3$\\
Therefore, $AB=\sqrt{AD^{2}+BD^{2}}=\sqrt{3^{2}+3^{2}}=3\sqrt{2}$\\
Therefore, $\cos B=\frac{BD}{AB}=\frac{3}{3\sqrt{2}}=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}$

method.method_draft: Use an auxiliary right triangle. From the grid image, note that B and C lie on the same horizontal grid line, and A is 3 grid columns to the right and 3 grid rows above B. Choose the lattice point D directly below A on the horizontal line through B; then BD is horizontal and AD is vertical, so angle ADB is 90 degrees. Count BD=3 grid units and AD=3 grid units, so AB=sqrt(3^2+3^2)=3sqrt(2). Since C lies on the same ray from B as D, angle ABC equals angle ABD. Therefore cos B = adjacent/hypotenuse = BD/AB = 3/(3sqrt(2)) = sqrt(2)/2.
